suggestions: Increase contrast slightly by darkening strokes or deepening fill separation so labels and boundaries read faster at a glance.
Tighten vertical spacing between layers to reduce excess whitespace and strengthen the staged pipeline feel.
Differentiate the central API/orchestration block more strongly from the peer query and ingestion blocks using size, weight, or fill emphasis.
Simplify or straighten the lateral connector into Ingestion so branch direction is more immediately legible.
Add a bit more internal padding or line spacing for two-line labels to improve readability in the larger rectangles.
